description: Dental is the first operational pilot vertical. The core RRT method remains vertical-agnostic; this profile defines dental-specific evidence, path and language rules.

target_segments.label: Prima visita / richiesta appuntamento
target_segments.customer_job: A potential patient finds the clinic and needs to understand how to ask for a first visit.

target_segments.label: Implantologia / riabilitazioni
target_segments.customer_job: A potential patient evaluates trust, technology, cost and appointment route for high-value care.

target_segments.label: Ansia / sedazione / dolore
target_segments.customer_job: A potential patient needs reassurance that the clinic understands fear, pain and sedation needs.

disallowed_collection: inventing conversion, revenue or patient loss

entity_identity_rules: Public name, address and official website must match the same studio or clinic.
Different dentists inside the same studio must not be merged unless public evidence shows shared entity/brand.
Google profile state must be observed with date before a Google-to-site continuity finding is promoted.
Entity ambiguity blocks Signal promotion and must be recorded as ENTITY_UNRESOLVED or ENTITY_CONFLICT.
observable_customer_path_signals: Google profile links or fails to link the official site.
Mobile official site shows or hides first-visit CTA, form, call, WhatsApp or booking route.
The patient can understand what to do for a first visit without interpreting generic content.
Comparator makes the same first action clearer for the same local decision context.
comparator_rules: Comparator must operate locally or in a clearly comparable patient decision market.
Comparator can be stronger digitally without implying superior clinical care.
Comparator evidence must focus on customer path clarity, not design taste.
Comparator review signals are public signals only, not clinical quality judgments.
red_team_falsification_prompts: Was the booking/contact path present but missed?
Is a phone-first workflow intentional and clearly communicated?
Is the comparator actually comparable or just digitally more mature?
Is the gap decision-relevant or merely aesthetic?
Are we confusing absence of evidence with evidence of absence?
Does the finding require unsupported clinical or economic claims?

client_language_constraints.safe_framing: Abbiamo osservato il percorso pubblico con cui un potenziale paziente trova lo studio e prova a chiedere una prima visita. Ci sono gia segnali positivi; il punto e rendere piu continuo e guidato il passaggio da Google al primo contatto.
forbidden_phrases: la vostra qualita clinica non emerge

contact_script_framing.opening: Rispetto per i segnali professionali gia presenti.
contact_script_framing.finding_style: Un punto pratico sul percorso pubblico di primo contatto.
contact_script_framing.offer: Mini-review gratuita del percorso Google -> sito -> richiesta visita.
contact_script_framing.must_not_do: No clinical criticism, no conversion claim, no pressure.

signal_promotion_rules: NO_SIGNAL when contact/first-visit path is already clear enough.
WATCHLIST when evidence is incomplete or phone-first may falsify the gap.
OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL_CANDIDATE only after entity, Google state, mobile path and comparator evidence exist.
OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL only after Red Team survives and human review approves.
